'''March 2001 Phoenix tournament (16 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 16 March 2001. [[Chris Shaner]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1925">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01d1925/ viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01d1925/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 March 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Shaner]]
